content.short: Safe is the leading smart contract wallet platform enabling secure multi-signature treasury and asset management for DAOs and teams on Mantle.
content.description: Safe (formerly Gnosis Safe) is the most trusted smart contract wallet platform in Web3, securing billions in assets for DAOs, protocols, and institutional teams with its multi-signature architecture requiring multiple approvals before any transaction executes. Originally launched in 2018, Safe has become the de facto standard for protocol treasury management and team asset custody. Safe is officially supported on Mantle Network and is widely used by Mantle ecosystem projects for secure fund management.

resources.title: Why protocols check for Safe before deploying
resources.tldr: New chains pitch throughput and fees, yet protocol teams ask first whether a multisig they trust already exists there. Argues that wallet infrastructure, not TPS, gates what actually launches.

resources.title: Beyond multisig: why approval isn't enough anymore
resources.tldr: Approval and control are not the same thing. A signer set records who is allowed to act, not whether the action itself is sound, which is the gap continuous treasury monitoring aims to close.

resources.title: The Best Crypto Wallets for Institutions
resources.tldr: Serving a team rather than a person changes what a wallet is judged on: approval policy, audit trail, role separation. Compares how the main institutional options handle each.
